comment: M1 intake allowlist. Source paths are relative to -SourceRoot (a Rainmeter skins config folder). Only these files are ever copied. Nothing else is read into the repo.
neverCopied: logs, caches, state files (*.txt, *.inc written at run time)
Rainmeter backups (*.rmskin) and the real desk config
the countdown overlay skin and any camera or gesture code
wallpapers, avatars, personal screenshots and photos
restore and backup folders from earlier desk work
anything outside -SourceRoot, and all git history
